source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, cash income taxes paid
source.quote: Cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds $ 6,035 $ 11,179 $ 12,308 Assets acquired under operating leases [USD millions; FY2024 is the 3rd figure in the row]

notes: Taxes: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet, net of refunds as presented. R&D not reported as a separate line. Amazon reports 'Technology and infrastructure' expense, which the 10-K says includes payroll for employees involved in research and development alongside store maintenance, AWS infrastructure and other costs; the filing does not call the line R&D, so it is not recorded.
